recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-20362 unless a future independent link-checking issue asks to change the LOINC URL scheme or destination.
issue_request: FHIR-20362 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction for the credits page. It reported that the LOINC link pointed to http://loinc,org with a comma and the accepted resolution was to correct the link.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-20362-tagged source commit was found in git history. The exact bad URL was introduced in commit 5fde4a70b9 and corrected in commit 2397d1ed10, which changed source/credits.html from http://loinc,org to http://loinc.org two days after the Jira was created.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml actively includes credits.html as the Community and Credits page, so source/credits.html is in current build scope. The current worker branch and combined branch both contain http://loinc.org on the LOINC credits link, and source grep found no remaining http://loinc,org typo. Jira full-text search for LOINC credits returned only FHIR-20362; Zulip had no hits, and Confluence had no direct FHIR-20362 references or relevant conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active credits source already reflects the accepted correction and no source-changing reconciliation is needed.
